title: Fluence Energy fiscal Q3 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At June 30, 2026 Fluence held USD 339.3 million of cash and equivalents, USD 392.2 million of convertible notes, USD 783.0 million of inventory and USD 328.2 million of unbilled receivables; top-three customers supplied 48% of nine-month revenue.
summary: The unchanged quarterly filing supplies exact cash, debt, dilution, working-capital, concentration, margin, backlog and operating-metric evidence for the full security review.
